say:0:1110624001:0.text: Strange, Merlin seems to be losing ground to his student...
say:0:1110624001:0.source_cn: 奇怪，梅林大人的法术完全被学生压制……
say:0:1110624001:0.male: Strange, Merlin seems to be losing ground to his student...
say:0:1110624001:0.female: Strange, Merlin seems to be losing ground to her student...

say:1:1110624002:0.text: Of course! He must be using this as a teaching opportunity!
say:1:1110624002:0.source_cn: 我明白了！这一定是梅林大人在借这个机会指导学生！
say:1:1110624002:0.male: Of course! He must be using this as a teaching opportunity!
say:1:1110624002:0.female: Of course! She must be using this as a teaching opportunity!

say:2:1110624003:0.text: How selfless! Merlin's drawing out the best of their former pupil!
say:2:1110624003:0.source_cn: 宁愿自己受伤，也要引出学生的全部实力吗？大魔法师的情怀...
say:2:1110624003:0.male: How selfless! Merlin's drawing out the best of their former pupil!
say:2:1110624003:0.female: How selfless! Merlin's drawing out the best of their former pupil!
